title: Dinner Lady Strawberry Bikini Shortfill E-Liquid
description: A cool, refreshing glass of lemonade is just what you need on a warm summers day. Strawberry Bikini by Dinner Lady goes further by adding fresh, juicy and sweet strawberries to a citrus crush for a delicious all-day vape. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
